name: Hangyaku no Beretta ~Ingoku ni Ochiru Senshi~
original_name: 反逆のベレッタ～淫獄に堕散る戦士～
source:
Enter a future world ruled by the culmination of biotechnology, which has its roots in the second half of the 20th century.
Mankind aspired to become gods, and so they created the replicants, artificial copies of themselves, whom they put to manual labor, sent to war as expendable soldiers and used at obedient slaves.

Then, the appearance of a single man changes everything. That man is professor Albert, who instigates a rapid evolution amongst the replicants. The replicants revere him as a god and declare war on what they call the "worthless humans". A great war erupts in which the replicants attempt to erase the utopia the humans created for themselves.

Before long, the entire world lies at their feet. Then a savior appears who stands and fights for humankind. This savior is Beretta, the only replicant who was not driven mad by professor Albert. Her battle is about to begin!

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE039843.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
走進一個由生物科技結晶所統治的未來世界。這項技術的根源可追溯至20世紀後半葉。
人類渴望成為神，於是創造了複製人——這些人造複製品被迫從事體力勞動，被當作消耗品送上戰場，還被用作唯命是從的奴隸。

隨後，一個男人的出現改變了一切。他就是阿爾伯特教授，促使複製人迅速進化。複製人將他奉若神明，並向他們口中的「無用人類」宣戰。一場大戰就此爆發，複製人企圖抹去人類為自己創造的烏托邦。

不久，整個世界都匍匐在他們腳下。就在這時，一位為人類挺身而戰的救世主出現了。她就是貝雷塔——唯一沒有被阿爾伯特教授逼瘋的複製人。她的戰鬥即將開始！

[摘自[url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE039843.html]DLsite English[/url]]
